findings.finding: Raw PID fields alone cannot authenticate lifecycle receipt; DOWN-first retention must be explicit.
findings.resolution: Private registration capability plus fresh per-participant operation capability, PID match; DOWN-first remains provisional until D.

findings.finding: Unbound completion token must not silently settle when scope retirement succeeds.
findings.resolution: Scope success refunds only transport capacity; unbound token retained as cleanup unconfirmed and prevents owner/instance stop success.
